payload.body: **ST0001 WP04: a ruling needed on bin/pplr and the suite's default.** WP04 deletes bin/pplr_resolve and bin/pplr_version (rule 3), and the legacy dispatcher bin/pplr calls both: for -v/--version and for every pplr:// marker argument. The Rust pplr no longer needs bin/pplr at all, because the fallback runs bin/pplr_<cmd> itself with bin/pplr's environment. tests/test_helper.bash defaults PPLR_UNDER_TEST to bin/pplr, which after WP04 cannot serve resolve, count, about, cp, open, linkedin, edit, meetings, refresh, grep, help or version. **My proposal (simpler, nothing new):** WP04 deletes bin/pplr, and the suite's default becomes the Rust binary ($PPLR_ROOT/target/debug/pplr; tools/bats-rust already builds it). The legacy behaviour stays pinned where it matters, in the goldens, which are captured from a git export of 507b0f6, not from the working tree. The other bin/pplr callers: setup.sh (ST0002 retires it) and pplr_handler, which bakes $PPLR_ROOT/bin/pplr into its app (WP08, already changing under the prebuilt-app ruling). The alternative is to keep bin/pplr as a two-line shim that execs the Rust binary. Your call; I'm carrying on with the rest of WP04 meanwhile.
